title: Linux OVAL check-type demonstration baseline
description: Demonstrates text-file, systemd, Debian package, RPM package, file ownership and permissions, and sysctl OVAL checks. Review distribution-specific package names, service names, ownership and modes before production use.

rules.title: Disable SSH root login
rules.description: Require PermitRootLogin to be set to no in the OpenSSH server configuration.

rules.title: Enable SSH public-key authentication
rules.description: Require PubkeyAuthentication to be enabled in the OpenSSH server configuration.

rules.title: Disable SSH password authentication
rules.description: Require PasswordAuthentication to be disabled in the OpenSSH server configuration.

rules.title: Disallow empty SSH passwords
rules.description: Require PermitEmptyPasswords to be disabled in the OpenSSH server configuration.

rules.title: Disable SSH X11 forwarding
rules.description: Require X11Forwarding to be disabled in the OpenSSH server configuration.

rules.title: Ensure Docker is running
rules.description: Require docker.service to report ActiveState=active through systemd.

rules.title: Ensure auditd is installed through Debian packages
rules.description: Demonstrate a native Debian package database check for the auditd package.

rules.title: Ensure audit is installed through RPM packages
rules.description: Demonstrate a native RPM package database check for the audit package.

rules.title: Protect the shadow password file
rules.description: Require /etc/shadow to be owned by root, grouped as root, and have mode 0600. Adjust the group and mode for distributions that use a dedicated shadow group.

rules.title: Enable address-space layout randomization
rules.description: Require the kernel.randomize_va_space sysctl value to be 2 for full ASLR.
